title: Mariposa Museum and History Center

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Venues include: ~Presentation and running of a 150-year-old Stamp Mill ~Experience gold panning as a gold miner! The museum features four water trough stations for gold panning, offering the opportunity to find pyrite, garnet, quartz, mariposite, and gold. ~Docent-led inside exhibit tour This tour focuses on local history, the gold rush, life in the 1800s, and the presence of Native Americans. ~The “Woodland” Gift Store This rotation offers an educational experience spanning from the 18th century to the modern day, including the study of currency.
